rationale: The agent did locate the user by name and ZIP and retrieved user and order details, but it performed order-changing writes without explicit user confirmation. It modified the shipping address for order #W6750959 and exchanged an item using modify_pending_order_items without first confirming the actions, violating the policy requirement to confirm before any write. It also referenced a product lookup (4768869376) but changed the item to a different product ID (9440686670) without showing how it determined it was the cheapest green option, making the change unsupported by the tools’ evidence. There is no clear verification that #W6750959 is the LA order, and no final confirmation or summary was provided to the user after the changes. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
